purpose: QA34 round2: distinct first-action motifs and combat aftermath that matches the saved environment.
style: Existing StavangerZ restrained painterly Nordic sea-green/slate/olive, weathered tactile materials, muted natural amber and April rain.
selectionContract: Select from the already-public saved experience kind plus its recorded illustration environment. Never infer an archived environment from mutable current-world data or rewrite historical experience facts/illustration fields. Existing combat.webp remains the residential/shop illustration.
limits: Cropped anonymous people/hands are fictional atmosphere, never portraits of a named crew member or proof of group size.
No image establishes a visible wound/death, injury cause, kill count, fatigue level, gear reward, resource quantity, operational power or named building.
Claim/POI/perimeter objects are symbolic framing; actual access, control, installed defenses and costs remain authoritative report facts.
Only the four combat variants are deliberately environment-specific. The neutral first-action motifs carry no real geographic coordinates or identifiable site.
No new loss/death asset is included; such an event requires an authoritative public-report contract first.
Images are local lazy assets for relevant cards; not a new graphic engine or a requirement to preload all of them.
